latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ACE-Step songwriting guide.

- Provides a comprehensive framework for writing captions, lyrics, and setting musical parameters for song generation.
- Defines structured output format: `Caption`, `Lyrics` (with tags), and music parameters (duration, BPM, key, time signature, language).
- Offers detailed principles and best practices for crafting effective captions across style, emotion, instrumentation, and more.
- Establishes guidelines for lyric structure using section tags, vocal/instrumental/energy cues, and methods to avoid generic "AI-flavored" lyrics.
- Includes tables for music metadata, when to set parameters manually, and practical duration estimation methods.
